questions.question: What disaster does Psalm 79 lament?
options: The scattered exiles at last returning home from far-off Babylon
The nations defiling the temple and laying Jerusalem in ruins
The king victoriously leading Israel on to a great triumph
The harvest failing entirely because of a long and bitter drought
questions.answer: The nations defiling the temple and laying Jerusalem in ruins

questions.question: What does Asaph ask God to do for his people?
options: Repay all the nations seven times over for their evil deeds
Raise up a mighty deliverer from the royal line of David
Help and atone for their sins for the glory of his name
Send rain to revive the parched and the dying land again
questions.answer: Help and atone for their sins for the glory of his name

questions.question: The psalm asks God not to remember former iniquities against them.
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your _____.
We your people, the sheep of your pasture, will give thanks to you _____.
